posture.rule: No feature is complete until a live user workflow has UI, API, realtime, permissions, mobile, Playwright/API evidence, and Emma Bot dogfooding where applicable.

status_legend.proven: Complete end-to-end, dogfooded, tested, and evidence attached.
status_legend.partial: Meaningful workflow exists but is incomplete or missing polish, permissions, realtime, mobile, or tests.
status_legend.shallow_needs_proof: Schema, route, store, or UI exists, but the full workflow has not been proven.

areas.name: Messaging
observed: Message routes, stores, MessageList, MessageInput, replies, reactions, pins, attachments, search, link preview, and thread UI names exist.
Non-author message delete now respects channel `MANAGE_MESSAGES`, with live API smoke coverage.
Typing indicators now require `VIEW_CHANNEL` and `SEND_MESSAGES` before broadcasting.

Live Playwright UI proof now covers the daily-chat actions end-to-end: send, edit (with 'edited' indicator), reply (with reply context bubble), react (badge visible), pin (visible in pinned panel), delete (row removed), attachment upload (1x1 PNG rendered as in the message row). reports/raw/messaging-ui-proof.json, 7 screenshots under reports/parity-screenshots/messaging-ui/.

Fixed an app bug surfaced while building the messaging harness: $currentUser was never restored after a full page reload, so isOwn was false and edit/delete/pin actions stayed hidden. Added restoreSession() to routes/servers/+layout.svelte.

Extended UI proof to cover two-client real-time WebSocket sync (one client sends a message, the other client instantly displays it in the DOM without refresh), jump-to-message (clicking the reply-context bubble scrolls to the original message), and a denied `SEND_MESSAGES` path (users without permissions are blocked in the UI and receive 403 Forbidden on the POST endpoint).
gaps: Grouping, date separators, upload progress, mention behavior, and E2EE channel decryption flow (not yet covered by Playwright; current proof covers the unencrypted upload path).
next_todos: Implement or prove message grouping and date separators.
Add Emma Bot chat script.

areas.name: Roles, Permissions, and Channel Overrides
observed: Role routes, permission bit definitions, channel override routes, RoleManager, RolePermissionsTab, and ChannelPermissionsTab names exist.
Several backend routes call server or channel permission checks.
First-pass hardening now blocks non-members from receiving default permissions in permission_check.

Voice, webhooks, slash commands, onboarding, audit log, threads, uploads, pins, reactions, search, forum, soundboard, recordings, E2EE groups, channel-scoped E2EE key packages, read-state, events, role-listing, role hierarchy, role permission subset checks, moderation target hierarchy, Discord-layered channel overwrite computation, channel list filtering, and channel override route gating received additional permission gates.
Live API smoke now proves a private channel is hidden and denied without the allowed role, then visible and readable after the allowed role is assigned.
Live Playwright UI proof now confirms private-channel hidden/visible behavior, channel permission override rendering, and role create/rename/delete from server settings.
Batch role reorder API now exists and validates role hierarchy before changing positions.
Role assign/unassign now checks target member hierarchy, so managers cannot change roles on same-position or higher members.
Manager-gated server and channel effective permission inspector endpoints now return bitfields and permission names.

Generated route inventory at reports/raw/route-inventory.json (schema v2) lists every Axum endpoint with method, path, auth class, path_kind, and detected permission/owner/author/member gates; covers 169 endpoints across 126 unique paths.

Inventory recognizers now classify own-resource paths (/@me, /me/, /friends, /push), detect inline owner/author/member checks, recognize named gate helpers (check_server_owner, is_dm_member), and resolve same-directory helper calls transitively so wrappers like require_event_visible lift gates onto their callers.

All 7 of the previous likely-real gaps are now gated and the build + 215 lib tests pass: list_rules in automod (MANAGE_SERVER), get_server / list_emojis / list_members / update_member (require_server_perm with VIEW_CHANNEL as the membership test), discovery patch (refactored to helpers::check_server_owner), and PUT/DELETE channel notification-settings (require_channel_perm VIEW_CHANNEL).
Live API denial smoke now covers all 8 new gates against https://opencorde.com (52 checks total, 0 failures).
gaps: Discord overwrite resolution behavior has core precedence tests plus live API and UI private-channel proof, but still needs a broader matrix.
Role and override UI has first workflow proof, but batch reorder and effective permission inspector UI remain unproven.
UI proof for batch role reordering/effective permission inspection and full MLS lifecycle proof still need work.

Route inventory needs_review is down to 6 routes, all accepted-by-design: GET /api/v1/servers (caller's own server list), POST /api/v1/servers (any authed can create a new server), GET /api/v1/users/{id} (Discord-style profile fetch open to any authed user), POST /api/v1/voice/leave + PATCH /api/v1/voice/state + DELETE /api/v1/channels/{channel_id}/stage/leave (own voice/stage state — leave is a no-op for non-participants). These are not handler gaps; they are intentional auth-only endpoints whose path shape the inventory's path_kind heuristic doesn't yet recognize. No action needed unless we add a 'caller_implicit' path_kind to suppress them.
next_todos: Add test matrix for owner/admin/mod/member/muted/banned users.

Add API denial smoke tests in scripts/permission_smoke.py covering the 8 new gates (automod list, get_server, list_emojis, list_members, update_member, discovery patch, set/reset notification settings).
Optionally add a 'caller_implicit' path_kind so the remaining 6 needs_review entries auto-classify; otherwise document them as accepted in this report.
Add regression tests for non-member denial and high-risk channel-scoped routes.

observed: LiveKit, voice state, device settings, video grid, recordings, soundboard, and stage panel names exist.

Stage detail/join/hand/speaker routes now enforce channel `CONNECT`, `REQUEST_TO_SPEAK`, `SPEAK`, and `MUTE_MEMBERS` on the API path.
Stage RTC publish grants now require both channel `SPEAK` and current stage participant role `speaker`; audience and demoted users get subscribe-only refreshed tokens.
LiveKit local service and public proxy health checks pass.
Admin stats now include LiveKit local and public proxy health for instance reporting.
Live /admin browser proof confirms the LiveKit Health panel renders Local and Public Proxy rows with OK status.

Manual two-client voice/video checklist added at reports/voice-two-client-manual-checklist.md.

2026-06-08: Two-client voice QA executed on GAMER (Windows) with real Chrome + audio hardware. Both clients joined voice, WebRTC proof captured via chrome://webrtc-internals: ICE completed, DTLS connected, outbound-rtp (opus, active=true), inbound-rtp (opus), media-playout, media-source, remote-inbound/outbound-rtp all present. Evidence: reports/voice-two-client/webrtc-internals-*.png, webrtc-audio-proof.png, voice-panel-*.png. Adaptive Opus bitrate controller (commit e683217) monitors packet loss + RTT every 3s and adjusts between 32-192kbps across 4 tiers with hysteresis.

2026-06-08: Stage channel store (stage.ts) implemented — startStage, endStage, joinStage, leaveStage, raiseHand, lowerHand, promoteSpeaker, demoteSpeaker with derived stores (speakers, audience, handsRaised). StagePanel component already wired in +layout.svelte for channel_type=3. Playwright QA test proves start→join→end flow.

areas.name: Account Security and Authentication
observed: All 12 auth API endpoints exist and are routed: register, login, refresh, forgot-password, reset-password, verify-email, resend-verification, 2fa/enable, 2fa/verify, 2fa/disable, steam, steam/callback.
Email/password login with Argon2id hashing, JWT access+refresh tokens, HttpOnly refresh cookie, JTI rotation with theft detection.
Password reset flow with 1-hour expiring tokens, one-time use, anti-enumeration (always returns 200), email sending.
Email verification with 24-hour tokens, resend capability for authenticated users.
TOTP 2FA with enable → QR/secret → verify → activate flow, login integration (TwoFactorRequired error code → client prompt), disable with code confirmation.
Steam OpenID 2.0 OAuth with redirect to Steam, callback verification, user find-or-create, JWT token generation.
Rate limiting on sensitive endpoints: login (5/min), register (3/min), password-reset (3/hour), messages (5/sec). Always-active strict limits regardless of global limiter state.
Fixed 2026-06-02: Rate limiter path prefix bug — password-reset endpoints (forgot-password, reset-password) were not covered by strict limiter because the prefix check used an incorrect path pattern.
Frontend: login page with email/password, TOTP prompt on TWO_FACTOR_REQUIRED, forgot-password inline form, Steam sign-in button.
Frontend: register page with email/username/password, invite code, Steam sign-up button.
Frontend: reset-password page with token from URL, client-side validation.
Frontend: verify-email page with loading/success/error states and navigation to login.
Frontend: TwoFactorSetup component in user settings with enable → QR display → verify → activate flow and disable with code.

Live API QA smoke: 19/19 checks pass against https://opencorde.com covering register, login, password reset, email verification, resend, TOTP enable/verify/disable, Steam redirect, token refresh, anti-enumeration.
Password change via settings endpoint (PATCH /users/@me) with current password confirmation for email changes.
Account deletion with password confirmation flow.
Security posture helper: require_verified_email_and_2fa() in helpers.rs gates sensitive actions on email_verified and totp_enabled at graduated levels.
gaps: No backup/recovery codes for 2FA (Discord offers these). Users who lose their authenticator device are locked out.
Steam account linking/unlinking from existing account not surfaced in settings UI (only available at initial registration/login).
Email verification status not surfaced in the settings UI (email_verified column exists but is not displayed).
Forgot-password and resend-verification emails are logged to tracing in development mode rather than sent (SMTP integration pending).
No dedicated password-change endpoint (change while logged in) — only forgot-password flow exists.
next_todos: Add backup/recovery codes for 2FA.
Surface email_verified status in settings UI.
Add Steam account linking/unlinking to settings.
Integrate production SMTP for transactional emails.
Add dedicated password-change endpoint for authenticated users.
